summary: NB Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its stock repurchase program. Since January 2025, through three programs, the company repurchased 6,371,044 shares (16% of IPO shares) at a weighted average price of $19.25. The final leg bought 2,207,236 shares (~5% of outstanding) at an average $20.96. Tangible book value per share stood at $18.00 as of March 31, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The repurchases were open-market; no fixed price or premium was set. Watch for future capital allocation priorities or whether the company initiates a new program.
